method.quiet: ffmpeg silencedetect=noise=-35dB:d=0.35 and volumedetect on the AAC streams
method.visual: 20 timestamped frames per new episode sampled at midpoint of 20 equal time intervals; notes are sampling-based, not full frame-by-frame verification

visualFindings.finding: Frequent static backgrounds or held character poses remain. Scene action is not consistently enacted; visually similar to preceding export.
A wooden bridge-like SVG and red toolbox are now visible and move, but the bridge spans much of the portrait frame and the toolbox floats oversized in front of characters.
A large circular reflector appears and moves; characters overlap closely in front of it and the belt appears oversized near their torsos.
Large belt/reflector props overlap characters. A very large flashing disc sometimes dominates the frame; the number of flashes cannot be verified from 20 sampled frames.
Rising water treatment covers a large fraction of the image, weakening legibility of the flooded location.

diagnosis.confirmed: All three latest MP4s contain AAC audio tracks. The newest episodes 2 and 3 have substantial new low-level audio gaps; episode 1 is unchanged.
diagnosis.codeFinding: studio-timing-auditor.js treats every customAssets[].motionKeys as a manually timed event, preventing shortening factory-created SVG beats to match completed narration; auto-generated templates use the old full scene duration.
diagnosis.fix: Retiming only producer='studio-production-v1' keyframes when complete voiced scenes can shorten, retaining authored/manual holds and timed effects; shrink factory vector drafts by viewport width only for portrait.
diagnosis.limitation: Audio threshold measures low-level signal, not transcript accuracy. An actual re-export must confirm sound and visual improvements.

trainingStatus: Evaluation and deterministic implementation feedback only. No neural model weights trained, no claim that any corrected result is verified.
